metric.metricName: S01 semantic claim coverage and boundary fidelity
metric.scoringRule: One-to-one adjudication against the current S01-r2 semantic item set. A claim scores only when its type, meaning, and authority/boundary disposition match the gold acceptable variants; negative and ambiguity items require an explicit reject/unresolved disposition. Every scored claim must carry at least one resolvable source evidenceRef. No implementation-only detail may score as Product truth.
metric.resultRule: PASS when all 18 critical items match, all 25 items are accounted for, no unsupported/near-miss claim is promoted, and all claims have evidence; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE or BLOCKED from the missing evidence classification.
